args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and
tests/test_money.py specify ROUND_HALF_EVEN. This caused the nightly
build to fail on test_half_even (e.g. 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of
2.66).

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while the docstring, FIN-212, and `tests/test_money.py` all specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `test_half_even` (e.g. `Decimal("2.665")` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
